hero.headline: Operational clarity on cloud and Kubernetes
hero.subline: We embed with engineering teams — cost discipline, resilient clusters, and automation that respects how you ship today.

contactLead.title: How we engage
contactLead.body: We begin with a short discovery call — scope, timelines, risks — then propose a pragmatic path: advisory, fractional platform support, or project-based delivery.

principalNote: FlyingSquirrel is led by a hands-on principal who has migrated multi-repo platforms, tightened AWS spend, and run production Kubernetes in anger.
